top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Advance on Tech Rebound, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rebounded from their biggest selloff in more than 18 months, with Taiwan leading gains after local authorities introduced measures to restore investor confidence. Crude oil fell, adding to the positive tone.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
